text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"--"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE:- 1) PROFILE CUTTING SHOULD BE DONE. 2) TO BE CASE CARBURISING DONE. 2) TO BE INDUCTION HARDENED UPTO 50 ~ 55 HRC. 3) CASE DEPTH 0.8~ 1.2 mm."}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is '--' while note N3 specifies case carburising and induction hardening, but neither states the manufacturing stage at which each treatment applies (e.g., before or after final machining). Without this sequence the shop cannot plan operations correctly, risking dimensional errors or inadequate hardness; the designer should update the title block to reference the treatments and add the required process order to the notes.","recommended_correction":"Replace '--' in the heat_treatment field with a reference to the applicable note, and revise note N3 to state when profile cutting, case carburising, and induction hardening occur relative to final machining."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 6 H7 (+0.012/0)"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D5","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 14 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Holes F1 and F2 carry tight H7 tolerances yet the part requires zinc plating per the surface_treatment field, and no allowance for plating thickness is indicated on these dimensions. Plating buildup inside tight holes will cause mating pins or shafts to fail to assemble; the designer should either adjust the pre-plate hole sizes to allow for coating thickness or add a note specifying that the H7 tolerance applies after plating.","recommended_correction":"Modify D4 and D5 to account for plating thickness, or add a note stating 'H7 tolerance applies after plating'."}]}
